firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently danced salsa, or any other Latin dance, starts as the Maraca Player.
clarifications: The Maraca Player then hands the maraca to the player on their left, who becomes the next Maraca Player.
internalEvidence: Rendered PDF page 2 gives the Latin-dance criterion. PDF page 1 says the player to the left of the previous Maraca Player takes the next round.
